ai_summary: Brij Rattan Bagri, the Promoter and Managing Director of BLB Limited, incrementally increased his stake in the company by acquiring 106,971 shares (0.21%) through open market transactions on September 11, 2026. This modest acquisition raised his total holding from 46.81% to 47.02%, subtly consolidating insider control. While no red flags are present, this move typically signals the promoter's continued confidence in the company's future prospects.
